shortDescription: Egypt's central bank kept its overnight interest rates unchanged on Thursday, it said in a statement.The monetary policy committee held the deposit rate at 19% and the lending rate at 20%.

children: Egypt's central bank kept its overnight interest rates unchanged on Thursday, it said in a statement.
The monetary policy committee held the deposit rate at 19% and the lending rate at 20%.
